name: Look up member savings balance
description: Look up member {{member_id}} and read the current savings balance

steps.description: Fill in the member number textbox with '{{member_id}}' to look up the member.

locator.rationale: The textbox is labeled 'Member number', so we use the role and label locator to target it precisely.

steps.description: Click the 'Find member' button using text locator as clicking by label role failed.

locator.rationale: The 'Find member' button is identified by its text; since clicking by label+role failed, clicking by exact text is the next best option.

steps.description: Extract the current savings balance value

locator.value: table[aria-label='Member account summary'] tr:has(th:has-text('Savings balance')) td
locator.rationale: Since targeting the cell or row by role or text times out, selecting the table row with a header 'Savings balance' and then its adjacent cell by CSS offers a structurally precise and performant way to extract the balance.
Stable page heading replaces a runtime-data checkpoint.

checkpoint.description: The member detail view is visible

locator.rationale: The server-rendered outcome has stable, user-visible copy.
